A '''skirmish''' took place on [[Nar Shaddaa]] between [[Boba Fett]] and [[Djas Puhr]] and his [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] who were hired to provide security for the [[information broker]] [[Sheraxx Quorsha]]. Fett blew open the door to Quorsha's building and was confronted by Puhr and his mercenaries. Fett quickly killed two of them with his [[ZX miniature flame projector|flamethrower]] and was engaged in melee combat by Puhr. The two remaining mercenaries hesitated to open fire because Puhr and Fett were too close together. Before they could fire their blasters, Fett wrapped up one with his [[whipcord launcher]] and used his body as a shield to stop the incoming fire. He then killed the last mercenary with his [[EE-3 carbine rifle]] before knocking Puhr unconscious with a headbutt. Once all the mercenaries were disabled, he confronted Quorsha and demanded information.<ref name="BFBWR3" />
